kjv: In my Father's house are many mansions
mine: In my Father's house are many dwelling places
note: mone is a place to stay (cf. 14:23 "make our home"); "mansions" (from Latin "mansiones", then meaning lodgings) now suggests great houses.

kjv: If ye shall ask any thing in my name
mine: If you ask me anything in my name
note: TR omits "me" (present in P66, Sinaiticus, B, W); with it, prayer is addressed to Jesus himself.

kjv: he (the Father) shall give you another Comforter
mine: he (the Father) will give you another Advocate
note: parakletos is one called alongside, a helper or advocate (1 Jn 2:1 of Jesus, KJV "advocate"); "Comforter" (Wyclif/Tyndale) narrows it. Also 14:26, 15:26, 16:7.
